service.en: Replace a driving licence issued by another country
service.ar: استبدال رخصة قيادة صادرة من دولة أخرى
service.ur: دوسرے ملک کے جاری کردہ ڈرائیونگ لائسنس کی تبدیلی
service.ml: മറ്റൊരു രാജ്യം നൽകിയ ഡ്രൈവിംഗ് ലൈസൻസ് മാറ്റൽ

about: Swap a foreign or Gulf driving licence from listed countries for a UAE licence.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: The licence comes from one of the specific countries the service accepts, or is a Gulf licence
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
an Integrated Transport Center service centre
